summary: Approved as readable, behavior-supported unmatched C++ with zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: Source preserves the original loop, ordered 16/16/4-byte copies, null-output handling and final destination value; ABI adaptation and limitations are explicit. Submitted tests call the original and compare full buffers and returns. Independent checks against Game.exe-extracted bytes passed 64,400 alignment/overlap cases at both O0 and O2, plus null/empty cases. Native Windows compilation records cover the actual implementation. Sampled validation does not establish all-input equivalence; faulting and wrapping cases remain unverified.
